recipe.matching: Same source English adapter,1120 slot order, labels,2epochs/280updates/LR1e-5/seed9217 as v1 treatment. Changes are evidence placement, speaker interleaving and removal of missingness/Update cues. No new matched restored-context arm; compare to v1 and original with that limitation.
recipe.selection: Maximize the worst generated answerability balanced score over two48-case validation layouts. Each layout must have over-refusal<=10%, supported-value matches>=its own baseline-1 and no generation failures. Step0 eligible; no challenge/user-based selection.
recipe.policy: The English model learns the standard refusal. Only an emitted exact refusal bypasses Singlish rewriting; no input-pattern refusal rules or context-policy layer are used in this experiment.
recipe.provenance: Position-balanced augmentation prompted by v1 transfer failures. Original main test/probes are now development diagnostics. Twenty new synthetic challenge rows frozen before v2 output inspection. No locked test or independent human benchmark.
recipe.hypothesis: Explicit abstention supervision must include supported facts earlier in a multi-turn history, not only the latest Update statement.
